title: Additivity of random restriction expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\delta\in\mathbb R$. For any real-valued functions $g$ and $h$ that assign a value to each choice of a free-coordinate subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and signs on its complementary coordinates, the random restriction expectation of their pointwise sum is the sum of their random restriction expectations.
hypotheses_covered: Functions $g,h$ on a free-coordinate subset and signs on its complement
